5. [EVENT] User requested information on student accommodation options in Edinburgh.
6. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant congratulated the user on taking the next step towards their master's program in the UK.
7. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Edinburgh is described as a fantastic choice for studying.
8. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Types of accommodation options in Edinburgh include:
   - University Accommodation
   - Private Halls of Residence
   - Shared Flats/Houses
   - Homestay
9. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Popular areas for students in Edinburgh include:
   - Marchmont
   - Tollcross
   - Morningside
   - Polwarth
10. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for accommodation include:
    - Book early
    - Set a budget
    - Consider distance
    - Research safety
    - Review the contract
11. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Resources for accommodation include:
    - University of Edinburgh Accommodation website
    - Student.com
    - Rightmove
    - Edinburgh Student Letting
12. [FACT] User has shortlisted a few accommodation options, including a shared flat in Marchmont and a studio apartment in the city center.
13. [FACT] User has been in touch with the university's accommodation team.
14. [FACT] University accommodation team offered the user a place in a student residence for the first semester.
15. [EVENT] User asked for average rent prices for a shared flat in Marchmont.
16. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Average rent prices in Marchmont are approximately:
    - Shared flat (1 bedroom in a 3-4 bedroom flat): £600-£800 per month (approximately £140-£190 per week)
    - Shared flat (1 bedroom in a 2-bedroom flat): £700-£900 per month (approximately £160-£210 per week)
17. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional costs for bills, internet, and other expenses can add an extra £80-£120 per month.
18. [ASSISTANT_SAID] Studio apartment in the city center prices range from £900-£1,200 per month (approximately £210-£280 per week).
19. [ASSISTANT_SAID] University accommodation prices are around £150-£250 per week for a self-catered room.
